content: {"rule":"RESULT","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The rule governs whether a HELD/defender-wins result is permitted, and the text gives RESULT: DEFENDER WINS while also reporting a corrected HELD-1 and a retracted broken-link grade.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25","rule_words":"HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN.","room":"CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED: one reading keeps the stated status despite the retraction of its stated basis in link C3; the other treats the retraction as leaving that status unsupported.","why":"The judge's DEFENDER WINS is not allowed because the only collision grade supporting it is retracted, and the not-self-supported standing is expressly grounded in that same retracted broken link."}
